answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a marble bet on surviving 50 epochs of grading, and every walnut settlement recomputes the falcon schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 50 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
